overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation in the notice complaint, but ordered the Committee to amend its deficient February 24, 2014 minutes, which it raised on its own initiative.

allegations.summary: A Committee member allegedly discussed charges or complaints against a shared staff employee during an open meeting without giving the employee 48 hours' notice.
Not raised by the complainant; the AG found the February 24, 2014 minutes too brief to show what was discussed in a nearly three-hour meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee's February 24, 2014 meeting lasted almost three hours, however the minutes contain only a few brief sentences.

remedy: Amend the February 24, 2014 meeting minutes so they contain sufficient detail to allow a member of the public who did not attend to understand what the Committee discussed.
remedy_passage: The Committee should, therefore, amend its February 24, 2014 meeting minutes so that they contain sufficient detail to allow a member of the public who did not attend the meeting to understand what the Committee had discussed.
